title: Shrine of the Death Lord
description: A shrine of polished bone and black iron rises from a circular clearing, its spire crowned with a skull that weeps trails of pale light. The air here is unnaturally still, and the silence presses against your ears like deep water. An offering bowl sits at the shrine's base, and chunks of soul ore are mortared into the altar's foundation.

choices.label: Pray at the shrine
choices.description: The death lord's blessing is a cold comfort, but comfort nonetheless.

outcomes.text: A wave of cold calm washes through your party. Wounds close and aches fade. The death lord accepts your supplication.
The skull's weeping light intensifies, and a profound stillness settles over your party. You feel restored beyond measure.
The death lord's attention is a double-edged sword. You feel healed, but a mark of cold fire burns itself into one hero's skin.

choices.label: Offer gold for a greater blessing
choices.description: A generous offering earns a deeper restoration from the lord of the dead.

outcomes.text: You place gold in the offering bowl. The coins dissolve into pale light, and a surge of restorative energy floods through your entire party.
The death lord is generous today. Your gold vanishes and your wounds knit shut completely. Even old scars fade.
The death lord takes the gold — and a little extra. Your wounds heal, but your purse feels lighter than it should.

choices.label: Pass the shrine in silence
choices.description: The death lord's gaze is not something to invite lightly.

outcomes.text: You lower your eyes and walk past. The skull's weeping light dims as you leave the clearing.
